Entry requirements

NCEA Level 2
Certificate/Diploma Level		Baccalaureat de l'enseignement secondaire with grade Passable
NCEA Level 3
Degree Level		Baccalaureat de l'enseignement secondaire with grade Assez bien , Bien , Tres Bien or Excellent
NCEA Level 2
Certificate/Diploma Level		Titulo de Bachiller OR Titulo de Técnico-Auxiliar
NCEA Level 3
Degree Level		Trayecto Técnico Profesional OR Successful completion of one (1) full year of tertiary studies at a recognised tertiary institution, OR Completion of an appropriate Otago Polytechnic pathway programme
NCEA Level 2
Certificate/Diploma Level		Successful completion of Year 12
NCEA Level 3
Degree Level		Successful completion of Year 12, AND ATAR score of 65 or above
NCEA Level 2
Certificate/Diploma Level		Kenya Certificate of Secondary Education (KCSE)
NCEA Level 3
Degree Level		Kenya Certificate of Secondary Education (KCSE) with B grade average
